prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Use quick tray controls to show, hide, or chat with your pet anytime.", "Click tray icon to toggle pet visibility; right-click for quick actions."]
1: ["Crafting Your Companion", "We are preparing your pet's desktop assets and animations."]
2: ["Signing in secures your pet so it never disappears when reopening the app.", "Your pet progress and customizations will automatically sync to this account."]
3: ["Upload & Preview Your Pet Photo", "Ensure pet face is clearly lit and centered for best results."]
4: ["Select Your Companion Journey", "Choose preset fast-track or full custom creation."]
5: ["If your pet disappears, click the system tray icon to show it on top of windows.", "Pro-tip: System Tray Quick Access"]
6: ["Pick Your Path"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion now. You can edit their name and personality anytime in app settings.", "Don't worry about picking the perfect name right away!"]
8: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Setting up sprite rendering engines and desktop integration."]
9: ["Save Your Companion", "Sign in to keep your pet synchronized across all your devices.", "Continue with Account"]
